svg.title: Five candidate fits of the same repairs, best AIC first
svg.desc: Small multiples of the five fitted densities over the same histogram of the fifteen repair times, ordered by AIC. Log-normal (AIC 48.50, BIC 49.92), gamma (AIC 48.65, BIC 50.07) and Weibull (AIC 49.28, BIC 50.70) all rise from zero, peak between about 1 and 1.5 hours and have a right tail; their curves look nearly alike. The exponential (AIC 52.19, BIC 52.90) is highest at zero hours, where no repair was that short. The normal (AIC 53.96, BIC 55.38) is symmetric around 1.96 hours and puts 6% of its probability below zero hours.
svg.text: Five candidate fits of the same repairs, best AIC first
Repairs per hour, as a density
Lower AIC and BIC are better.
